title: The points of canonical extensions of doctrines
summary: We analyse the space of points of the canonical extension of a coherent doctrine. We first give a full characterisation of doctrine morphisms that are extensible, and relate it to the existing notion of p-model of a coherent category. Through this characterisation, the extensible morphisms are shown to be exactly those which are ω-saturated in the sense of coherent first-order logic. Next, we answer the question: when does a presheaf of models fully describe the canonical extension?
